chunks: From him, from Yaʿqūb ibn Yazīd, from Ibn Abī ʿUmayr, from Hishām ibn Sālim, from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
There is no harm in a man performing salat (prayer) over the deceased after he has been buried.

key_terms.لَا بَأْسَ: there is no harm; an expression indicating permissibility
key_terms.يُصَلِّيَ: to perform salat (prayer), here meaning to pray over the deceased

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to perform salat over a deceased person after burial?
ai.summary: This hadith states that it is permissible to perform salat (prayer) over a deceased person even after burial. It indicates a legal allowance related to funeral prayer and the rites connected to the dead.
